Yes Optus store: walkthrough

You're standing in the mall, where the first photo was taken. The back-of-house door is at the rear left of the store.

  • WASD walk, mouse to look, Shift walk faster
  • E open / close the door when you're near it
  • C compare with the nearest original photo (50% overlay)
  • H toggle help, Q toggle quality, Esc release mouse

Controls
